conceptual_lineage_corrections: Canyon/Delta/Ecotone/Fjord/Granite are hardforks, not sequential L1 contract releases; later chains start with them at genesis.
U8 changed authorization/storage while the SuperchainConfig end-of-block implementation stayed v1.1.0.
U12 is Pectra maintenance, not the Holocene SystemConfig v2.3.0 transaction.
v2.1.0, v2.2.0 and v3.0.1 are later maintenance branches dated after their numbered bases; they are not protocol nodes between U13/U14/U15.
U15a is the prestate/activation dependency for U15, not a new contracts release.
U16a creates a real U16-retain-lockbox versus direct-U15-no-lockbox fork; all four tracked chains took U16 first.
U18a is Arena-Z-only and does not sit on the four target chains' state path.
U19 and U19b are the L1-contract and Karst-activation phases of one Upgrade 19b governance bundle, not two independent global releases.
U20 does not enable interop or shared dispute infrastructure; U21 ships migrate() code but does not call it.
